outcome: Kidney injury markers (LRG1, KIM1, NGLA, HIF11A, CASP3)
Innate immune activation markers (MPO+ cells, complement molecules, oxidative stress, TLR2, TLR4, S100A9, LTF, LYZ)
Th1 responses (CD3+ cells, IFNG/IL4 ratios, TBET/GATA3 ratios)
cohort: The participants were preterm pigs, used as a model for preterm infants, delivered at 90% gestation.
finding: Prenatal endotoxin exposure induced fetal and postnatal renal inflammation in preterm pigs through both innate and adaptive immune activation.
